presentationProfile.title: SendPilot
presentationProfile.description: Manage LinkedIn outreach campaigns, track lead statuses, and monitor credit balances with SendPilot

addLeadsToCampaign.description: Adds one or more leads with profile attributes and custom fields to an outreach campaign

createLeadDatabaseSearch.description: Initiates an asynchronous B2B lead search matching professional, company, and technology filters

createLeadExtractorCampaign.description: Launches a scraping job to extract and enrich leads from LinkedIn or Sales Navigator search URLs

getCampaign.description: Retrieves detailed configuration, lead metrics, and connected sender accounts for a specific campaign

getConversationMessages.description: Retrieves message history and attachments for a specific LinkedIn conversation thread

getCredits.description: Retrieves current credit balances, subscription quota, and usage across workspace features

getLeadById.description: Retrieves profile information, company data, and outreach history for a specific lead

getLeadDatabaseSearchResults.description: Retrieves paginated lead records and contact details from a completed database search

getLeadDatabaseSearchStatus.description: Checks the execution progress and completion status of a lead database search job

getLeadExtractorCampaignResults.description: Retrieves paginated lead profiles, job history, and contact information from a finished extraction job

getLeadExtractorCampaignStatus.description: Retrieves the progress percentage and extraction status of a lead scraping campaign

listCampaigns.description: Retrieves a paginated list of LinkedIn outreach campaigns filtered by status

listConversations.description: Retrieves LinkedIn message threads across connected sender accounts with continuation token pagination

listLeads.description: Retrieves a paginated list of leads filtered by campaign ID and outreach progress status

listSenders.description: Retrieves connected LinkedIn sender accounts along with daily message limits and usage

sendConnectionRequest.description: Dispatches a LinkedIn connection request with an optional note to a target profile.

sendMessage.description: Sends a direct message to a LinkedIn profile URL using a connected sender account

sendMessageToLead.description: Sends a templated LinkedIn message directly to an existing lead by lead ID

updateCampaign.description: Pauses or resumes an existing outreach campaign

updateLeadStatus.description: Updates the progression status and notes for a specific lead
